messages:
Maya Patel: Quick capacity pulse for Lumen — sharing the 7d summary. GPU hours up ~18% week-over-week. Nightly saturation spikes on rtx-40xx pool (three separate windows last 48h). Queue depth peaked at 42, avg ~11. P95 latency for generation routes on that pool drifted from ~260ms -> ~420ms. Any obvious recent changes? cc @Jin Park @Alex Chen

OpsBot: [alert] pool-rtx-40xx saturation >85% (3 events, last 48h). Alerts: /ops/alerts/RT40-2026-4821

Jin Park: looking. pulling scheduler logs and recent deploys. my first pass: we had a batch-window tweak on Mon (2s -> 4s) to improve throughput for embeddings. that could explain higher concurrency.

Alex Chen: I also noticed a noisy job from tenant:lumen-job-472 that kept respawning with higher token consumption. I drained it around 03:12 UTC and requeued. It was holding many slots.

Jin Park: logs excerpt:
```
pool=rtx-40xx queue_depth=42 active_tasks=36 avg_latency_ms=412
tenant=lumen job=472 tokens/s=720
```

Jin Park: proposed mitigations: 1) revert batch-window to 2s on rtx-40xx (low risk) 2) set temporary pool-scale +2 GPUs for the next 24h during nightly windows 3) add queue-depth alert at 30 and auto-scale policy to add 1 card when triggered. can implement change in canary then rollout. ETA ~6h for canary -> monitor.

Sofia Lopez: From CS: Lumen PM reported timeouts on several embedding jobs last night and opened a support ticket. Their renewal is next quarter — we need to show concrete mitigation. Can eng commit to the above plan today?

Alex Chen: agree with Jin. I'll open a Jira and add runbook steps: cap per-tenant concurrent jobs to 6, enforce backpressure on long-running token-heavy jobs, and add a temporary mitigation tag for Lumen so we can prioritize their queue.

SupportBot: Created ticket CS-1289 "Lumen saturation spike investigation" assigned to Alex Chen. Priority: P2.

Maya Patel: Thanks — can we also capture a quick before/after dashboard snapshot to send to the PM after the mitigations? I'll coordinate the customer comms. :thumbsup:

Jin Park: will push canary revert and alert config now. I'll post updates in this thread once canary metrics settle (~30–45m).

Alex Chen: Jira created: INFRA-9423, assigned eng-infra. I added rollback steps and the cap enforcement PR link.

Maya Patel: Perfect. If metrics look stable after canary, we'll schedule a short status call with Lumen tomorrow morning. Thanks team.

Jin Park: update: canary reverted batch-window -> 2s. initial canary metrics: saturation down to 62%, queue_peak dropped to 18, p95 latency ~280ms. rolling to remainder of pool in 15m.

Maya Patel: Awesome. I'll prep the summary for the PM and attach the canary graphs.

Alex Chen: leaving a note: follow-up item to add tenant-level burst quotas to prevent recurrence.

Sofia Lopez: Noted. I'll add renewal risk flag if we see any recurrences. For now status = mitigated (monitoring).
